thread:
Maya: FYI ACME POC can't log into the Dedicated pool after we enabled SAML+SCIM in Okta. Users appear in SCIM but SSO fails with 'NameID does not match'. Hosted API keys for service accounts also getting 401s.
Amit: @Maya which Dedicated cluster (region) and can you paste a sample SAML assertion NameID vs the user email?
Maya: us-west-2-dedicated-3. Attaching snippet from Okta (redacted): NameID -> sAMAccountName (acme_jdoe), user.email -> j.doe@acme.com
Amit: that mismatch explains it. Redwood expects NameID to map to the user's email (NameID format emailAddress) or you can set a claim that maps NameID -> user.email. In Okta: Sign On > Edit SAML > Attribute Statements / NameID. Example we recommend:
```
NameID format: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
NameID value: user.email
```
Jordan (ACME IAM): we used sAMAccountName to match AD, changing NameID to email will break other apps.
Amit: understood. Two options: 1) change NameID to email in Okta for the ACME app only, 2) keep sAMAccountName and ask Redwood to accept that mapping and link identities server-side. Option 1 is fastest.
Jordan (ACME IAM): SCIM already provisioned users with externalId = sAMAccountName so after changing NameID we saw a 409 duplicate on login.
Amit: that's a race/duplicate identity issue we've seen — SCIM created an account before SAML assertion matched the identity, resulting in two records. Workarounds: delete the SCIM-created user and re-trigger SSO after NameID change, or request an identity merge from infra. Deleting may affect audit/history.
Leah: security note — avoid deleting if possible. Merge preferred. @infra-bot can you check merge options for tenant acme-corp?
infra-bot: Ticket INF-4927 opened for identity merge for tenant acme-corp. Assigned to infra-team, ETA ~2h.
Carlos: customer asked if we can issue a temporary Hosted API key so they can continue API tests while SSO is fixed. Scope-limited key ok?
Amit: yes, we can issue a scoped Hosted API key (read/write limited) with short TTL. I'll create one limited to 100 req/min and 24h expiry.
Maya: Jordan can you confirm you can change NameID for the Redwood app? If yes we'll do it then retry login after merge.
Jordan (ACME IAM): changing NameID for this Okta app now, ETA ~10m.
infra-bot: Identity merge completed for tenant acme-corp. Please have user retry login.
Jordan (ACME IAM): Login succeeded. SCIM group sync assigned 'redwood-poc' role. API calls that previously 401 now return 200.
Maya: awesome. Next steps: Amit please add an Okta NameID mapping screenshot and a short checklist to the POC runbook (SSO config, SCIM mapping, merge fallback). Also note the Hosted API key fallback procedure.
Amit: will update runbook and ping when done.
Leah: add a short blurb about audit implications of deleting users and recommend merge path.
Maya: thanks everyone — I'll summarize for ACME and close the loop. :thumbsup:
